META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml.text:
modLoader="javafml"
loaderVersion="[4,)"
license="LGPLv3"
issueTrackerURL="https://github.com/yungnickyoung/YUNGs-Better-Dungeons/issues"

[[mods]]
    modId="betterdungeons"
    version="1.21.1-NeoForge-5.1.4"
    displayName="YUNG's Better Dungeons"
    credits="Thanks so much to all my patrons!"
	authors="YUNGNICKYOUNG, Acarii"
    description="A complete redesign of Minecraft's dungeons!"
	logoFile="logo.png"
    displayURL="https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/yungs-better-dungeons-neoforge"

[modproperties.betterdungeons]
    catalogueImageIcon="catalogue_icon.png"
    catalogueBackground="catalogue_background.png"

[[dependencies.betterdungeons]]
    modId="minecraft"
    type="required"
    versionRange="[1.21, 1.22)"

[[dependencies.betterdungeons]]
    modId="neoforge"
    type="required"
    versionRange="[21.0.0,)"

[[dependencies.betterdungeons]]
    modId="yungsapi"
    versionRange="[1.21.1-NeoForge-5.1.3,)"
    type="required"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

[[mixins]]
    config = "betterdungeons.mixins.json"
